notes.title: No HUD mode added
notes.notes:
To further immerse into the world or for someone looking for the challenges, now you can turn off the HUD in the 'Camera menu'.

Enjoy the new immersive Lakeside!

notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
-Item pick up radius have increased from 0.5cm to 2.5cm


-Character rendering issue while cutscene event have fixed


-Performance optimization

Overall hardware usage increased (better framerates)


-New unique attack patterns for boss characters

In order to make boss encounters more dynamic, new attack patterns were added for boss characters.


-2 new melee weapons (Kitchen Knife, Shovel)

Kitchen Knife and Shovel were added, just for fun.

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
To improve gameplay experience, various features are added

- Feature Update

1. New gears class items added

To incourage players to find shooting ranges, new gear class items were added as reward


2. More crafting item class

To add more depth to the resource management, new crafting item classes are added


3. Fuel Management system added

Now driving requires fuels.


- Patch

1. Performence optimization

As a result of CPU usage improvement, frame rates arround lakeside area has greatly improved

2. Item drop rates adjustment

item drop rate has adjusted, for new item classes are added



Rouge will be keep updated until version 2.0.0
new contents and game modes will be updated in the future.

notes.title: Shooting Range Added
notes.notes:
-Shooting Range

To help you understanding with shooting mechanism, 
Shooting Ranges were added to openworld of Lakeside. 
It is not an official update yet. 
But within few weeks, it will be fully featured with in game rewards(for shooting range completion).


-Performance Optimization

Utilizing more CPU resources. (Increased frame rate, Increased CPU usage but necessary)

Steaming time reduced. (Decreased frame hitches when streaming levels)

notes.title: 1.0.4 Crafting System Updated
notes.notes:
To add more depth to resource management, now crafting system has implented. 
8 crafting materials were added and it can be used to craft ammo, health kit, etc... 
Manage your resources stratigically in order to survive in Lakeside.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Cutscene bug fix

HUD improvements - more interactive informations on the HUD.

Objective notification - for more intuitive navigation.

Major performance enhancement - 20% CPU usage decreased, 30% memory usage decreased.
